name: Total incarceration rate per 100,000

anchors.source: Combined prisons+jails per 100k peaked ~1000 in the late 2000s and has fallen to ~530–560 by 2022–2023. L=150 anchors near OECD-peer levels (e.g., Western Europe ~100–150); U=750 anchors below the historical U.S. peak so a return to that peak maps clearly toward the low end of the 0–100 score.

vintage_note:
